entry.title: ScenePilot: Grow-and-Repair Policy for Text-Driven 3D Indoor Scene Generation

author.name: Jiawei Zhang, Hongsong Wang, Pan Zhou

entry.summary: ScenePilot is a retrieval-augmented grow-and-repair framework for text-driven 3D indoor scene generation, using hierarchical layout priors plus learned rectification to fix invalid layouts incrementally. Improves over one-pass and heavy post-hoc optimization approaches.

entry.title: PRISM: Predictive Recomposition via Semantic Latent Decomposition for View-invariant Video Representation Learning

author.name: Youngchae Chee, Hosu Lee, Sungjune Park, Junho Kim, Yong Man Ro

entry.summary: PRISM decomposes cross-view video into view-invariant and view-variant latents and enforces that invariant features can be recomposed with arbitrary variant features, yielding better disentanglement for egocentric/exocentric action understanding.

entry.title: Real-Time Scene-Adaptive Tone Mapping for High-Dynamic Range Object Detection

author.name: Gongzhe Li, Linwei Qiu, Peibei Cao, Fengying Xie, Xiangyang Ji, Qilin Sun

entry.summary: Proposes neural photometric tone mapping optimized end-to-end with downstream detection to bridge HDR RAW inputs and LDR sRGB-trained detection networks for autonomous driving. Replaces the traditional ISP pipeline with task-aware mapping.

entry.title: CANVAS: Consistency-Aware Navigation via Visual Adaptive Sampling for Long-Context Text-to-SVG Generation

author.name: Yichen Wu, Haoxuan Qu, Yihang Lou, Hossein Rahmani, Jun Liu

entry.summary: CANVAS is a training-free, render-aware inference framework for long-context text-to-SVG generation that combines trajectory likelihood with visual feedback from rendered futures and adaptively allocates samples by uncertainty and influence. Improves global consistency of autoregressive generation.

entry.title: Camera trap classification with deep learning under ground truth uncertainty

author.name: Leonard Hockerts, Peter S. Stewart, Sarthak Arora, Tiffany J. Vlaar

entry.summary: Investigates training camera-trap classifiers under ground-truth uncertainty from volunteer label disagreement, finding training on uncertain labels can improve accuracy, especially on hard images, though cross-dataset generalization effects are mixed. Nuanced finding for citizen-science-trained models.

entry.title: Whole-Body MRI Classification via Prompt-Based Clinical Conditioning

author.name: Laura Daza, Marta Hasny, Cristina Gonz\'alez, Julia A. Schnabel

entry.summary: TACTIC is a prompt-based multimodal framework integrating whole-body MRI with structured clinical variables via conditional visual feature learning, handling arbitrary numbers of tabular inputs and missing data without imputation.

entry.title: SurgSkill-Bench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Surgical Skill Assessment

author.name: Chaohui Dang, Zheheng Jiang, James Glasbey, David Luke, Theodoros Arvanitis, Le Zhang

entry.summary: SurgSkill-Bench is a video-score-text benchmark with 214 surgical simulation videos, six-dimensional OSATS scores, and expert free-text comments, defining video-only and comment-assisted skill-prediction settings. Supports automated surgical skill assessment research.

entry.title: Multi-View Reflective Surface Inspection via Semantic-Saliency Cross-Verification

author.name: Van-Giang Nguyen, Thanh-Tuan Tran, Xuan-Hieu Phan, Xiem HoangVan

entry.summary: This paper presents a multi-view inspection framework for reflective smartphone cover glass that cross-verifies VLM-generated semantic boxes against class-agnostic saliency from normal-reference reconstruction to rank defect proposals. It handles viewpoint-dependent defect visibility in industrial quality control.

entry.title: VeriCam: A Verification Baseline for the Classification of Unknown Data

author.name: Lucas Wojcik, Gabriel E. Lima, Sergio M. Silva Jr., Eduil Nascimento Jr., David Menotti

entry.summary: VeriCam is a zero-shot classification pipeline that leverages verification-trained image models to build specialized feature spaces for fine-grained, minutiae-based separation that standard foundation models lack. It targets classification of unknown classes in unseen data.

entry.title: Coronary Mask Guided Registration for Continuous Time 4D Cardiac CT Dataset Construction

author.name: Yuang Wang, Shuo Wang, Changyu Chen, Dufan Wu, Pengfei Jin, Yunqiang An, Yang Gao, Bin Lu, Dongrui Dai, Muge Du, Yan Yan, Dong Li, Liang Li, Li Zhang, Zhiqiang Chen

entry.summary: CMGR constructs pseudo-ground-truth continuous-time 4D cardiac CT sequences from clinical multiphase reconstructions using coronary-mask-guided registration with the ED/ES phase as reference, reducing motion artifacts especially in the right coronary artery. It addresses ground-truth scarcity for 4D cardiac CT research.

entry.title: ConCA: Concentration-Aware Channel Attention for Fine-Grained Visual Recognition

author.name: Yu-Sheng Liu, Yu-Chen Tung

entry.summary: ConCA proposes concentration-aware channel attention pairing channel means with a shift-invariant negative-input entropy descriptor, jointly encoding magnitude and spatial concentration for fine-grained recognition with negligible parameter overhead. It fixes the information loss of global average pooling in lightweight attention modules.

entry.title: System Identification of Admittance Models for Large Real-World Objects

author.name: Nathan I. Baum, Nathaniel G. Luttmer, Mark A. Minor

entry.summary: Presents the first complete workflow for identifying physically consistent admittance models of large real-world objects such as doors and wheelbarrows, separating handle and body identification without torque sensors at constrained joints. Guarantees physical consistency of inertia and friction parameters for use in haptic simulation.

entry.title: MiBOT: A head-worn robot that modulates cardiovascular responses through human-like soft massage

author.name: Alice Mylaeus, Stephanie Vogt, Berken Utku Demirel, Marcel Gort, Mirko Meboldt, Manuel Meier, Christian Holz

entry.summary: MiBOT is a head-worn massage robot using two soft pneumatically actuated tactors with silent, contact-pressure-responsive control to mimic human head massage. A controlled study measured blood pressure and heart rate responses to assess cardiovascular modulation effects.

entry.title: A Dual-Cam Parallel Elastic Actuator with Shared Gas-Spring Compensation for Humanoid Ankles

author.name: Jingcheng Jiang, Yifang Zhang, Nikos G. Tsagarakis

entry.summary: Proposes a 2-DoF parallel elastic actuator for humanoid ankles with a dual-cam, single-gas-spring architecture that shares one elastic element for pitch and roll torque compensation, plus a coupled mathematical model capturing interdependence of the compensation units.

entry.title: Robust Semi-passive Velocity Field Control with Boundedness Guarantees for Safe Interaction between Mechanical Systems and Physical Environment

author.name: Van Trong Dang, Sumitaka Honji, Takahiro Wada

entry.summary: Develops robust semi-passive velocity field control with boundedness guarantees for safe physical interaction between mechanical systems and their environment, relaxing the conservatism of fully passive control while retaining safety under external disturbances.

entry.title: Online Gate-Driven Flow Control in Resin Transfer Moulding Using a Neural-Network Surrogate

author.name: Nicholas Wright, Oliver Maclaren, Piaras Kelly, Suresh Advani, Ruanui Nicholson

entry.summary: Combines an iterated extended Kalman filter for estimating race-tracking strengths from pressure sensors with neural-network surrogate models replacing finite element simulation, enabling real-time gate flow control in resin transfer moulding to prevent dry-spot formation.

entry.title: Pixel-wise Geo-registration of Drone and Satellite Images

author.name: Qingyang Liu, David G Shatwell, Parth Parag Kulkarni, Mubarak Shah

entry.summary: Introduces SkyReg, a dataset and benchmark for pixel-level drone-to-satellite geo-registration providing dense per-pixel geodetic supervision across projections and scene types, and evaluates broad baselines where prior work offered only per-image GPS labels. A solid benchmark contribution for cross-view geometry.

entry.title: Agents for Everyone: A Workshop Framework for Building Agentic AI Capabilities in a Distributed Curation Community

author.name: Seth Carbon, Sierra Moxon, Kimberly Van Auken, Pascale Gaudet, Christopher J. Mungall

entry.summary: Describes a JupyterHub-based cloud environment using Claude Code as a universal harness to give Gene Ontology Consortium curators hands-on agentic curation capability, paired with an interactive training workshop for the curation community. Tackles adoption barriers of access and training rather than new algorithms. A valuable case study of agentic AI uptake in scientific knowledge infrastructures.

entry.title: Resource Constraints and Performance in Agentic AI Systems

author.name: Amaz Salman, Malka Halgamuge, Teo Susnjak

entry.summary: Compares two complete agentic systems, OpenClaw and NanoBot, on paired benchmarks with instrumentation, finding a statistically inconclusive 31 versus 25 percent full-completion gap and quantifying how resource mechanisms shape capability and operational burden. An honest null-result systems evaluation. Modest scope but methodologically careful with bootstrap intervals.

entry.title: From Documents to Reasoning: A Validated Synthetic Data Pipeline and Semantic-Aware Fine-Tuning for Financial Numerical Reasoning

author.name: Lokendra Birla, Milind Savagaonkar, Visnu Srinivasan, Sowmya Rasipuram, Shubhashis Sengupta

entry.summary: Builds a validated synthetic data pipeline and semantic-aware fine-tuning approach for financial numerical QA spanning tables, charts, and narratives, and critiques exact-match metrics that miss unit and format variations, misleading performance assessment. Competent industrial-flavored applied research. Useful evaluation critique paired with known data-generation techniques.

entry.title: CASTANET: Causality-Aware Spatio-Temporal Adversarial Network Using Traffic Incident Effects

author.name: Toshiya Kitahara, Ryu Shirakami, Koh Takeuchi, Hisashi Kashima

entry.summary: Integrates spatio-temporal graph neural networks with a causality-aware adversarial design that incorporates sparse, spatially and temporally biased incident records to forecast non-periodic incident-driven congestion, a regime where periodic forecasting models perform poorly. Tackles a genuinely hard prediction problem for intelligent transportation. Solid domain methods contribution from an experienced Kyoto group.

entry.title: Memristive-Friendly Hadamard Reservoir Computing: Structured, Multiplier-Free Recurrences at Scale

author.name: Andrea Ceni, Gianluca Milano, Carlo Ricciardi, Claudio Gallicchio

entry.summary: Replaces dense recurrent matrices in memristive-friendly reservoir computing with a structured, multiplier-free orthogonal operator built from sign diagonals, a permutation, and a fast Walsh-Hadamard transform, achieving O(N log N) per-step compute and O(N) parameters without materializing the matrix. Neat hardware-aware algorithmic design for neuromorphic computing. Specialized but elegant.

entry.title: UIC-AIHealth4All at ArchEHR-QA 2026: Answer-First Evidence Grounding for Clinical Question Answering

author.name: Mohammad Arvan, Hossein Haeri, Natalie Parde, Rebecca T. Feinstein

entry.summary: This system paper describes the UIC-AIHealth4All entry for the ArchEHR-QA 2026 shared task on grounded clinical QA over electronic health records, featuring an answer-first pipeline that generates candidate answers citing note sentences before classifying the full evidence set, plus self-consistency voting for answer-evidence alignment. It ranked third in evidence identification. A competent shared-task contribution with modest generalizable insight.

entry.title: FVeinSyn: Synthetic Finger Vein Image Generator

author.name: Yifan Wang, Jie Gui, Adams Wai Kin Kong, Baosheng Yu, Changsheng Chen, Qi Li, Zhenan Sun, James Tin-Yau Kwok, Alex Kot

entry.summary: FVeinSyn is a controllable synthetic finger-vein image generator that decouples vascular topology synthesis (via stochastic L-systems under physiological constraints) from imaging appearance, addressing the scarcity of large-scale public biometric datasets. It enables identity-diverse, anatomically valid training data for finger-vein recognition. From a strong biometrics group.

entry.title: Tensor-Accelerated Eager Multi-Resolution Grids for Evolving Large-Scale Substrates

author.name: Romain Claret, Michael O'Neill, Paul Cotofrei, Kilian Stoffel

entry.summary: This work tensorizes ES-HyperNEAT indirect encoding for neuroevolution, replacing the sequential quadtree subdivision with tensor-accelerated eager multi-resolution grids so that large-scale substrates can evolve efficiently on modern hardware. It removes batching and sequential-dependency obstacles in CPPN-driven network placement. A systems-level enabler for neuroevolution research.

entry.title: Curvature-Aware Radius Shrinkage for Adaptive Nearest Neighbor Classification

author.name: Alexandre L. M. Levada

entry.summary: CARSANN adapts nearest-neighbor classification by shrinking each neighborhood's spatial support according to local manifold curvature, estimated via intrinsic dimensionality (TwoNN) and a shape-operator formulation. This replaces fixed k with geometry-driven local neighborhoods for data whose local complexity varies. A thoughtful classical-ML contribution with geometric grounding.

entry.title: Evaluating Loss Functions in Differentiable Out-of-Domain Sound-Matching with Partial Parameter Distance

author.name: Amir Salimi, Daniel Penner, Kalvin Eng, Abram Hindle, Osmar R. Za\"iane

entry.summary: This paper introduces Partial Parameter Distance, enabling parameter-loss evaluation of out-of-domain sound matching where target and imitator synthesizers lack a shared parameter space, verified with blinded listening tests. It evaluates four differentiable loss functions across seven OOD scenarios including filtering, modulation, and pitch bending. A careful measurement-methodology contribution for audio synthesis.

entry.title: How Much Can AI Understand? Toward AI-Assisted Sensemaking of Collaborative Discussion in Groups with Shared History

author.name: Soobin Cho, Mark Zachry, David W. McDonald

entry.summary: Drawing on studies of experienced Wikipedia editors, this work proposes an AI-assisted sensemaking model for collaborative discussions that incorporates group social context, norms, hierarchies, and shared history rather than treating discussions as standalone text. It highlights how context-blind AI risks misrepresenting meaning in group communication. A thoughtful CSCW-grounded framing for discussion-support AI.

entry.title: Low-Altitude Fluid Antenna Network with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Tong Zhang, Yanfei Su, Shuai Wang, Wanli Ni, Chengzhong Xu, Huseyin Arslan

entry.summary: This paper applies multi-agent reinforcement learning to fast fluid-antenna reconfiguration in low-altitude wireless networks serving UAVs and eVTOL aircraft, where dynamic channels, blockages, and heterogeneous interference motivate reconfigurable antenna positions. It targets real-time, high-performance FA control toward practical deployment. Domain-specific wireless application of established MARL methods.

entry.title: Compared to What? A Human-Anchored Security Benchmark for LLM-Generated Infrastructure-as-Code

author.name: Animesh Shaw

entry.summary: This paper proposes a layer bit-width allocation method for LLM quantization, formulated as latency (performance) maximization under a quality-degradation budget, applied to Gemma-3-1B via TensorRT-LLM with a layer sensitivity profile from prior SA-PTQ work. It differs from uniform GPTQ/AWQ-style quantization by allocating precision per layer group. Practical mixed-precision deployment engineering on a single small model.

entry.title: Spatial-Semantic Reasoning using Large Language Models for Efficient UAV Search Operations

author.name: Marin Maletic, Marijana Peti, Tamara Petrovic, Stjepan Bogdan

entry.summary: A real-time UAV semantic navigation framework where an LLM reasons over detected objects and spatial context to prioritize search regions for Object Goal Navigation, combined with 3D mapping and spline trajectory planning. Emphasizes operation outside simulators on real hardware.

entry.title: MaCoPlanner: LLM-Assisted Manual-Compiled Task Planning with Proactive Safety Verification for Robotic Industrial Panel Operation

author.name: Guipeng Xin, Jiahe Xua, Mohammad Deghat, Chenhui Wan, Jie Liu, Youmin Hu, Zhongxu Hu

entry.summary: MaCoPlanner converts industrial equipment manuals into a typed intermediate representation for LLM-assisted task planning in robotic panel operation, with symbolic rollout verification against procedural and state constraints before actuation.

entry.title: PanelShield: Verifiable Closed-Loop Safe Planning for Robotic Industrial Panel Operation

author.name: Guipeng Xin, Jiahe Xu, Chenhui Wan, Jie Liu, Youmin Hu, Zhongxu Hu

entry.summary: PanelShield provides verifiable closed-loop safe planning for industrial panel operation, using dual formal verification with LTL and a Safety FSM to enforce temporal correctness and localize violations for repair of foundation-model-generated plans.

entry.title: Cross-Spectral Dense Correspondence for Multimodal Spectral Medical Imaging

author.name: Eric L. Wisotzky, Jost Triller, Simon W. H\"artl, Oliver T. Bruns, Peter Eisert, Anna Hilsmann

entry.summary: Introduces a sensor-agnostic cross-spectral modulation protocol and synthetic benchmark for dense correspondence in multimodal spectral medical imaging, where non-overlapping spectral sensitivities cause appearance shifts that break RGB-trained models.

entry.title: Anatomy-Aware Promptable Segmentation with Online Interactive Training for AUTOPET V

author.name: Pablo Lozano-Jimenez, Sergio Romero-Tapiador, Ruben Tolosana

entry.summary: An anatomy-aware promptable segmentation family of nnU-Net models for whole-body lesion segmentation in FDG and PSMA PET/CT, developed for the AUTOPET V challenge with online interactive scribble-prompt refinement and a tracer classifier.

entry.title: An Enclosed Mode Is a Gauge Choice: Topology Relative to Reach in Certified Code World Models

author.name: Javier Aguilar Mart\'in

entry.summary: Characterizes what a certified code world model can know beyond its verification gate, proving that unreachable-region topology errors can be unfalsifiable and bitwise harmless, framed as a gauge choice. Includes LLM synthesis experiments across three model families.

entry.title: Unsupervised Latent Space Alignment with Hyperspherical Geodesic Matching

author.name: Cameron Ryan, Vivek Sivaraman Narayanaswamy, Kowshik Thopalli, Shusen Liu

entry.summary: Introduces HGA, aligning latent spaces of independently trained networks without shared anchor samples by directly optimizing transformations that maximize hyperspherical geometric fit. Answers whether geometric signatures alone suffice for alignment.

entry.title: RL-FAT: Reinforcement Learning for Fair Adversarial Training

author.name: Tejaswini Medi, Levan Mikeladze, Margret Keuper

entry.summary: RL-FAT uses policy-gradient feedback on class-wise adversarial predictions to equalize robust accuracy across classes during adversarial training, addressing the class-wise disparities that average robust accuracy masks.

entry.title: Towards an Expressivity-Normalized Energy-Demand Comparison of ANNs and SNNs

author.name: Miriam Kranzlm\"uller, Pascal Esser, Gitta Kutyniok

entry.summary: Develops an analytical framework comparing ReLU ANNs and spiking neural networks at matched expressive capacity, deriving expressivity-normalized efficiency ratios and thresholds for when event-driven computation wins on energy.

entry.title: Supraglacial Lake Fate Is Knowable Long Before the Season Ends

author.name: Emam Hossain, Md Osman Gani

entry.summary: Measures how early in a melt season the fate of Greenland supraglacial lakes (drain, refreeze, burial) becomes predictable, truncating satellite inputs at 14 cutoffs to find the earliest per-class resolution times.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning for Symbolic Equation Solving

author.name: Kevin P O Keeffe

entry.summary: Presents an RL agent solving symbolic equations step by step with a dynamic action space and tree-structured policy, matching prior best on CommonCore under reward-only training and handling change-of-variables families via a supervised generator.

entry.title: Multivariate Scientific Data Compression with Learned Cross-Variable Latent Decorrelation and Autoregressive Entropy Modeling

author.name: Liangji Zhu, Anand Rangarajan, Sanjay Ranka

entry.summary: Presents CAESAR-LDAR, an error-controlled learned compressor for multivariate scientific fields combining a trainable exactly-invertible orthogonal cross-variable latent transform with an autoregressive entropy model.

entry.title: BCPPO: Bachelier-Inspired Constrained Proximal Policy Optimization for Tail-Risk-Aware Safe Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Dongsheng Hou, Yanqiao Chen, Yuhan Rui

entry.summary: Proposes BCPPO, a constrained PPO method for tail-risk-aware safe RL that converts cost-critic disagreement under random sample masks into a smooth Bachelier-formula-based policy penalty, targeting rare high-cost events without CVaR gradient noise.

entry.title: Foundation Models Meet Agriculture: Challenges Beyond Pretraining

author.name: Vishal Nedungadi, Xingguo Xiong, Marc Ru{\ss}wurm, Ioannis N. Athanasiadis

entry.summary: Systematically investigates why earth observation foundation models perform poorly on agricultural tasks, benchmarking pretraining scale and adaptation bottlenecks across heterogeneous agricultural landscapes. It identifies task-specific adaptation gaps as a key obstacle. Valuable diagnostic work for remote sensing and food-security applications.

entry.title: TopGQ: Fast GNN Post-Training Quantization Leveraging Topology Information

author.name: Dain Kwon, Kanghyun Choi, Hyeyoon Lee, Sunjong Park, Seoyong Lee, Sukjin Kim, Jinho Lee

entry.summary: Proposes TopGQ, a post-training quantization framework for GNNs featuring dual-axis scale absorption into the adjacency matrix and a topology proxy (TopPIN) for grouping structurally similar nodes. It reduces quantization time by an order of magnitude while preserving accuracy. Addresses real deployment overhead for GNN quantization.

entry.title: MolLedger: An Additive Graph Neural Network with Chemically Grounded ADME Attributions

author.name: Christina X. Ji

entry.summary: Proposes MolLedger, an additive graph neural network whose outputs are sums of per-atom scores, yielding exact built-in interpretability for ADME prediction at no performance cost, with attributions more faithful to chemical properties than post-hoc explanations. A neat architecture-level answer to the attribution problem in molecular ML. Single-author work, which somewhat limits verification.

entry.title: Distributed Semantic Segmentation With Improved Rate-Distortion Trade-Off

author.name: Danish Nazir, Timo Bartels, Thorsten Bagdonat, Tim Fingscheidt

entry.summary: This paper designs two new source codecs for distributed semantic segmentation, allowing extremely low-bitrate transmission between edge encoders and cloud decoders while improving the rate-distortion trade-off. It addresses a key constraint in split inference for dense perception tasks.

entry.title: ASTRA - Agentic System for Ticket Resolution and Analysis

author.name: Shashidhar Reddy Javaji, Mohamed Trabelsi, Jin Cao, Huseyin Uzunalioglu

entry.summary: ASTRA is a multi-agent system for IT incident ticket resolution, with specialist agents for historical-case retrieval, log distillation, and documentation, coordinated by an orchestrator and a judge loop producing evidence-backed reports. It emphasizes provenance so outputs are verifiable when evidence is sparse.

entry.title: Validating FKG.in: Soundness Assessment in LLM-Augmented Indian Food Knowledge

author.name: Saransh Kumar Gupta, Armaan Shah, Lipika Dey, Partha Pratim Das, Ramesh Jain

entry.summary: Presents a semi-automated soundness assessment workflow for validating LLM-augmented recipe data within FKG.in, an Indian food knowledge graph, targeting hallucinated ingredients, structural inconsistencies, and culturally implausible combinations in LLM-extracted culinary content.

entry.title: Transformer-Based Flow Shop Scheduling Using MILP-Generated Training Data

author.name: Roderich Wallrath

entry.summary: Formulates non-permutation flow shop scheduling with secondary resources as next-token prediction over job-machine-resource tuples, training a transformer on MILP-generated schedules and completing random prefixes at inference.

entry.title: Partition-Aware Unlearning for Removing Spurious Correlations in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Aditi Sarker, Nazreen Shah, Rafi Ibn Sultan, Rhongho Jang, Dongxiao Zhu, Prashant Khanduri

entry.summary: Introduces PURGE, a framework for constructing, benchmarking, and mitigating spurious object-background correlation failures in large vision-language models, including a partition-aware unlearning method. Addresses the lack of controlled benchmarks for context-shortcut predictions.

entry.title: PromptKWS: A Novel Prompt-Guided Open-Vocabulary Keyword Spotting Framework

author.name: Gaopeng Xu, Chengfei Li, Xianliang Wang, Lin Zhu, Juan Wei, Wenpeng Li, Jianwei Niu, Jie Gao

entry.summary: Presents PromptKWS, a prompt-guided open-vocabulary keyword spotting framework with a Prompt Phrases Prediction Network and prompt-acoustic cross-attention, improving wakeup rate by over 10% over baselines. Adapts well to noisy real-world deployment environments.

entry.title: Argument-Aware Semantic Alignment of Normative Texts: A Toulmin-Based Neuro-Symbolic Approach

author.name: William Schroeder

entry.summary: Builds a neuro-symbolic pipeline combining LLM argument explicitation (Toulmin claims, grounds, warrants, qualifiers) with neural representations for aligning normative texts such as cross-standard requirements, showing argument structure adds information complementary to semantic similarity.

entry.title: Memory-First Fact-Checking: A Knowledge-Graph-Grounded Multi-Agent System for Misinformation Detection

author.name: Amelia Petrenciuc, Alexandru Lecu, Adrian Groza

entry.summary: Introduces a memory-first, web-fallback fact-checking framework combining knowledge-graph semantic retrieval with NLI and an adversarial tribunal of support, contradiction, and judging agents, plus a graph-aware confidence mechanism for explainable misinformation detection.

entry.title: Vocabulary Growth Fundamentals: Bernstein Functions and Hausdorff Sequences

author.name: {\L}ukasz D\k{e}bowski

entry.summary: This is a mathematical survey modeling expected vocabulary growth (number of word types) in stochastic processes through Bernstein functions and Hausdorff sequences, connecting them to Poisson point processes, IID processes, and hapax rate models. It proves the logistic hapax rate model has a non-negative spectrum, defining a Bernstein function and resolving an open question. The work deepens the theoretical foundations of vocabulary growth laws.

entry.title: The Language of the Question Selects the Market: Query Language and Exit IP as Separable Factors in Commercial Recommendations from a Generative Search Interface

author.name: Dmitrij \.Zatuchin

entry.summary: This paper reports a controlled probe of 234 runs against the logged-out ChatGPT interface and OpenAI API across four exit countries and six query languages, finding that query language rather than location decides which market's products are recommended, and that top recommendations are unstable across identical runs. Data was collected 29-30 August 2026, essentially concurrent with the coverage date. It offers practical transparency findings for generative search behavior.

entry.title: Responsible Integration of AI in Cancer Genomics: Barriers, Risks, and Pathways to Trustworthy Clinical Translation

author.name: Bahar \.Ilgen, Yiannos Tolias, Denise K\"uhnert, Paraskevi Papadopoulou, Magnus Westerlund, Dominik Heider, Katharina Ladewig, Georges Hattab

entry.summary: A review of responsible AI integration in cancer genomics, covering literature mining, variant interpretation, trial matching, knowledge graphs, and multimodal integration, and identifying translational failure domains including explainability, data governance, and evidence inconsistency. A position/review piece on trustworthy clinical translation rather than new methods.

entry.title: Evaluating Constrained Iterative Refinement for Scalable Vector Graphics Generation with Off-the-Shelf VLMs

author.name: Matthew Perlman, James Beetham, Niels Da Vitoria Lobo, Amrit Singh Bedi, Mubarak Shah

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates constrained iterative refinement for SVG generation with off-the-shelf VLMs, finding constrained decoding improves compilation success while refinement exposes deficits in visual reasoning and self-correction. Diagnostic study of VLM capability limits on a neglected modality. Moderate insight into inference-time unlocking of new skills.

entry.title: Growing a Stand, Not a Tree: Joint Canopy Generation Reproduces Crown Shyness

author.name: Guang Yang, Fengchen Liu

entry.summary: Formulates stand-level forest canopy generation as set generation with a flow-matching model whose tree-to-tree attention is the only coupling channel, showing a joint model halves clearance-distribution error versus per-tree generation, reproducing crown shyness. A conceptually elegant probe of relational structure in generative models.

entry.title: MANTLE: A Framework for Adaptive In-Situ Planetary Perception Using a Modular Uplink Principle

author.name: Pranav Durai, Gary Doran

entry.summary: MANTLE is a multi-task adaptive network for in-situ planetary perception, using a shared DINOv2 backbone with task-specific heads for landform classification and boulder segmentation, plus a modular uplink principle for mission-adaptive updates. Relevant to autonomous planetary robotics.

entry.title: ActiveAugment: Online Active Learning for Augmentation Selection in Deep Learning

author.name: Noah Videcrantz, Mostafa Mehdipour Ghazi

entry.summary: ActiveAugment treats data augmentation selection as an online active learning problem, scoring candidate augmented views per minibatch using predictive uncertainty and feature discrepancy, and selecting the augmentation under which the model is most fragile. A unified, model-aware alternative to static augmentation policies.

entry.title: Elastic Triangle Splatting

author.name: Tian Shi, Shenhan Qian, Daniel Cremers

entry.summary: Elastic Triangle Splatting analyzes kernel-function choices in triangle splatting as a generic differentiable bridge between 3DGS-style rendering and mesh-based polygonal pipelines, with systematic optimization-behavior analysis of boundary kernels. Bridges neural rendering and classical graphics workflows.

entry.title: SGPDFuse: Semantically-Guided Physics-Disentanglement General Multi-Modal Image Fusion

author.name: Haozhen Wei, Chengjun Jiang, Yutong Guo, Xinrui Ju, Xingyuan Li, Xiang Chen, Jinyuan Liu

entry.summary: SGPDFuse performs general multimodal image fusion by mapping inputs into a physics-disentangled structural representation using pretrained vision foundation models, decoupling invariant scene attributes from environmental degradations. A semantic alignment mechanism guides the decomposition. Addresses the common failure of blind feature aggregation in image fusion.

entry.title: AGRICAM: A Track-Mounted Crop Pollination Monitoring Robot

author.name: Malika Nisal Ratnayake, Adel N. Toosi, James Cook, Romina Rader, Alan Dorin

entry.summary: AGRICAM is a purpose-built track-mounted robot for large-scale pollinator and crop monitoring in protected farming systems, autonomously traversing crop rows with dual camera systems. It applies computer vision to a high-value agricultural monitoring problem at commercial scale. Primarily a systems/robotics contribution with an embedded CV pipeline.

entry.title: AOI-Net: Structural Face AOI-Guided Eye-Gaze Track Representation Learning for Autism Spectrum Disorder Detection

author.name: Zhanpei Huang, Binbin Sun, Jialiang Chen, Yiou Wang, Taochen Chen, Yuzhu Ji, Yiqun Zhang, Yiu-Ming Cheung

entry.summary: AOI-Net models eye-gaze behavior over semantically meaningful Areas of Interest with structural representations for autism spectrum disorder screening, capturing attention allocation and transitions rather than only short-range fixation dynamics. Non-invasive ASD screening from eye movement is a high-value clinical application. The work is task-specific but addresses a genuine medical need.

entry.title: Calibration and Comparative Analysis of Forward-Looking Sonar and 3D Sonar for Enhanced Underwater Object Recognition

author.name: Aditya Penumarti, Khanh Dong, Zi-Hao Zhang, Yongkyoon Park, Zhenqi Wu, Trung Dong, Shahriar Negahdaripour, Xiaomin Lin, Jane Shin

entry.summary: Calibrates and compares forward-looking 2D sonar and 3D sonar for underwater object recognition, using auto-calibration to filter noisy cross-modal features. Auto-calibration improves performance over manual calibration by 5 percent and filtering boosts feature extraction by over 40 percent versus raw point clouds. Includes code and data, valuable for an under-resourced domain.

entry.title: Repeatability Characterisation and Error Budget of a Consumer Structured-Light Scanner for 3-D Wound Geometry:A Rigid-Phantom Study

author.name: Pushkal Kumar, Aadit Aggarwal, Karlen Aleksanyan

entry.summary: Characterizes measurement error of a consumer structured-light scanner for 3D wound geometry, finding 95% repeatability limits so poor that rescan variation can exceed clinically meaningful change in surface area. A valuable cautionary negative result for medical 3D scanning.

entry.title: SELECT: SELEctive Context Transfer for Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Avi Gupta, Saurabh Yadav, Koteswar Rao Jerripothula, Tammam Tillo

entry.summary: SELECT introduces Selective Context Transfer for class-incremental semantic segmentation, grounding each new class in semantically similar past classes to better exploit prior knowledge against catastrophic forgetting and background shift.

entry.title: Knowing Beyond the Known: Reinforced Knowledge Specification for Multi-Label Class-Incremental Learning

author.name: Aoting Zhang, Dongbao Yang, Chang Liu, Xiaopeng Hong, Can Ma, Yu Zhou

entry.summary: KBK proposes reinforced knowledge specification for multi-label class-incremental learning, explicitly modeling known vs unknown knowledge boundaries to unify historical, current, and future learning under incomplete co-occurring labels.

entry.title: AQ3D: Adaptive Query Transformer for 3D Instance Segmentation

author.name: Keno Moenck, Thorsten Sch\"uppstuhl

entry.summary: AQ3D adapts transformer decoders for 3D instance segmentation to scenes of varying size by instantiating queries as a fixed ratio of superpoints with scale-invariant positional encoding, avoiding fixed-query over/under-initialization.

entry.title: Cost-efficient Active Learning for Referring Image Segmentation and Grounding

author.name: Junbeom Hong, Seonghoon Yu, Hyung Rok Jung, Sundong Kim, Jeany Son

entry.summary: Formulates active learning for visual grounding under the realistic text-free setting, generating auxiliary region-text pairs with foundation models and introducing a Referred Region Ambiguity acquisition function to select images needing discriminative expressions.

entry.title: A Composition-Aware Pretraining Framework for Geospatial Foundation Models

author.name: Aryan Kashyap Naveen, Abhishek Srinivas, Pranav Moothedath, Shrutilipi Bhattacharjee

entry.summary: Proposes a composition-aware pretraining framework for geospatial foundation models that predicts fractional land-cover histograms per cell via Earth Mover's Distance, capturing the compositional nature of satellite scenes. Yields substantial downstream gains.

entry.title: Reliable Benchmarking of Artifact Detection in Computational Pathology: A Reproducibility and Uncertainty Analysis

author.name: Konstantinos Moutselos, Ilias Maglogiannis

entry.summary: Proposes a reliability protocol for artifact-detection benchmarks in computational pathology, quantifying test-set sampling, training stochasticity, partition composition, and preprocessing variability, requiring claims to survive all four sources. Applied to an independent replicate.

entry.title: TAMI: Temporally Aligned, Missingness-Aware, and Interpretable Multimodal Fusion for Mental Health Assessment in Older Adults with Mild Cognitive Impairment

author.name: Merna Bibars, Bolaji Omofojoye, Allan I. Levey, Rachel Hershenberg, Gari D. Clifford, Hyeokhyen Kwon

entry.summary: TAMI provides temporally aligned, missingness-aware, interpretable multimodal fusion for mental health assessment in older adults with MCI, correcting temporal misalignment and modality dropout in remote clinical interviews with joint attribution to modalities, questions, and moments.

entry.title: Computational Depth Measurement in Thermographic Video: Overcoming Spatial Overfitting via Spatio-Temporal Decoupling

author.name: Zain Ul Abidin, Habeeban Memon, Junaid Ahmed

entry.summary: This paper addresses subsurface delamination depth measurement in CFRP from pulsed thermography videos, using a spatio-temporal decoupling architecture to combat spatial dataset bias when calibration defects follow regular grids. It separates defect localization from temporal depth regression to learn physical heat-diffusion relationships.

entry.title: Dual Park-Ravani Interpolation of Rigid Motions: Acceleration-Field Continuity and Holonomic Hermite Repair

author.name: Daniel Condurache

entry.summary: This theoretical work transfers the Park-Ravani spline construction to orthogonal dual tensors, proving interpolation of rigid poses with continuous body dual twist, its first derivative, and a continuous physical acceleration field via dual Jacobian Fréchet derivatives. It is a differential-geometry contribution to smooth motion interpolation.

entry.title: From Multi-Modal Paths to Executable Trajectories: A Trajectory Planning Framework for 4WIS Robots

author.name: Runjiao Bao, Lin Zhang, Yongkang Xu, Shoukun Wang

entry.summary: This paper presents a multi-modal global trajectory planning framework for four-wheel independent steering robots, extending Hybrid A* to a 4D state space with motion modes plus mode-consistent segment-wise optimization and multi-modal Reeds-Shepp curves. It better exploits 4WIS maneuverability in tight spaces.

entry.title: A Hybrid PEM-GP Framework for Uncertainty-Aware System Identification of Quadcopters

author.name: Abdallah Ghoul, Ismail Khalil Bousserhane, Kadri Boufeldja

entry.summary: A hybrid physics-plus-Gaussian-process framework for uncertainty-aware system identification of quadcopters, combining interpretable physics-based models with data-driven residual learning that carries calibrated uncertainty estimates for reliable control.

entry.title: Open-Source Autonomous Driving System Analysis and Multi-Disciplinary Hardware-in-the-Loop Research Paradigm with Reinforcement-Learning Testing and Large Language Models

author.name: Dianjing Cheng, Yike Li, Lan Yang, Shan Fang, Wenjia Niu, Xiangyu Shi, Xinyi Zhao, Yunzhe Tian, XingYu Wu, Xiaoshu Cui, Yuanwan Chen, Jialu Sun, Zhongli Wang, Biao Liu, Jiaqi Yang, Jinghui Feng, Feifei Su, Juan Du, Shuangde Fang, Yi Qian, Huiyun Li, Yuansheng Liu, Peng Sun, Mingming Wan, Nan Chen, Ruipeng Gao

entry.summary: Analyzes an open-source autonomous driving system (Apollo on a Hongqi EV) and proposes a real-vehicle experimental framework connecting multi-vehicle deployment with recordable, reviewable experimental processes, hardware-in-the-loop testing, RL-based testing, and LLM assistance across distributed teams.

entry.title: The Structure of Merging Turbulent Jets Beneath a Small Quadrotor

author.name: Anoop Kiran, Nora Ayanian, Kenneth Breuer

entry.summary: A particle image velocimetry study characterizing the merged turbulent downwash beneath a small hovering Crazyflie quadrotor, resolving higher-order statistics and their relation to canonical jet scaling at the low-Reynolds-number end of the size range, with implications for multi-rotor formation spacing.

entry.title: Population ethics is a big deal, which is why I made this population ethics quiz

author.name: MichaelDickens

entry.summary: An interactive population ethics quiz that diagnoses whether a person's moral views on population change contradict each other or carry counterintuitive implications, arguing population ethics is central to many consequential ethical decisions.

entry.title: Let's fund weird AI safety projects

author.name: Ihor Kendiukhov

entry.summary: Argues AI safety funding strategies should explicitly include radical and unusual projects, because under most stated timelines and risk models the fat-tailed upside of high-variance projects justifies reallocating some funding toward them.

entry.title: Under-Mattress Temporal Sensing for Next-Day Agitation Risk Scoring in Dementia Wards

author.name: Zhen Liu, Marta Bono, Robbe Decloedt, Ajda Flisar, Maarten Van Den Bossche, Maarten De Vos

entry.summary: Analyzes 423 patient-nights from 65 subjects in a specialized dementia unit using under-mattress sensors to predict next-day agitation risk, benchmarking four paradigms from handcrafted nightly summaries to sliding-window multiple-instance learning under patient-wise splits. A clinically meaningful question with a careful comparative design. Applied health ML of moderate novelty.

entry.title: Generative AI Alignment with Hinduism's Theological Plurality and Sacred Representation

author.name: Dipto Das, Arpita Kundu, Nusrat Jahan Mim, Shion Guha, Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed

entry.summary: Uses 15 semi-structured interviews with Bangladeshi Hindu participants to examine how users interpret AI-generated religious explanations, devotional interactions, and synthetic sacred media, arguing that alignment discourse over-centers secular Western and Abrahamic assumptions. A valuable pluralistic-alignment contribution grounded in HCI methods. Important perspective, small qualitative scope.

entry.title: SETU: An Agentic Ecosystem for Multilingual, Persona-Aware Communication Coaching

author.name: Jonnalagadda Maruthi Tejas, Uponika Barman Roy, Tilottama Goswami, Samir Goswami, Mousita Dhar

entry.summary: Presents SETU, an agentic ecosystem for multilingual, persona-aware corporate communication coaching that decomposes assessment of sales pitches and recruiter calls into auditable component outputs rather than black-box scores. Only one of its two scoped scenarios is evaluated due to limited resources. A useful applied system for workforce training with an explainability emphasis.

entry.title: An Empirical Evaluation of Cross-City POI Recommendation on a Large-Scale Benchmark

author.name: Peibo Li, Yang Song, Hao Xue, Maarten de Rijke, Flora D. Salim

entry.summary: Re-evaluates state-of-the-art cross-city point-of-interest recommendation on the large-scale Trip World benchmark, finding that hometown-aware models lean on destination-region priors rather than genuine user preference transfer, that accuracy-efficiency trade-offs degrade at scale, and that the simplest models remain competitive. A useful reality check driven by a large benchmark. Solid empirical audit for the recommender community.

entry.title: GOD: Govern, Observe, and Direct - A Real-Time Control Room for Agent Societies

author.name: Yige Luo, Ran Guan

entry.summary: Builds GOD, a local-first control room for generative-agent societies combining live Ask and Intervene commands, spatial replay, studios for agents and maps, and portable experiment packs, centered on a command-and-artifact loop for inspecting and steering runs. Addresses the inspectability gap in multi-agent simulation tooling. Useful research infrastructure rather than a method advance.

entry.title: Automated Analysis Framework for Multilingual Climate-Health Literature Based on Multi-Agent Large Language Model

author.name: Yuze Sun, Shihui Zhang, Jiancheng Pan, Yunjia Ye, Wentao Luo, Jiahao Li, Quan Zhang, Wenjia Cai, Xiaomeng Huang

entry.summary: Deploys a multi-agent LLM framework automating screening, structured information extraction, and standardized integration across multilingual climate-health literature, with a central coordination module and three specialized agents. Addresses a real interdisciplinary synthesis bottleneck. Applied pipeline work with limited methodological novelty.

entry.title: Beyond Task-Only Matching: Personalized Skill Routing with Counterfactual Evaluation

author.name: Tianle Wang, Yanghe Zou, Xiang Liu, Ziyao Huang, Chenchen Fu, Weiwei Wu

entry.summary: Formulates personalized skill routing as profile-conditioned retrieval, where the same request should map to different skills depending on user constraints, and introduces a profile-counterfactual benchmark that exposes failures of task-only semantic matching, plus counterfactual-evaluation-based routing. Sharpens an increasingly relevant agent-component problem. Nicely targeted contribution.

entry.title: LandingAgent: A Reference-Annotated Dataset and Agentic Generation Framework for Landing Pages

author.name: Injun Baek, HyeongSeok Lee, Yearim Kim, Junhoo Lee, Nojun Kwak

entry.summary: LandingAgent introduces LandingBench, a reference-annotated dataset abstracting real landing pages into section sequences, layout patterns, tone, and CTA structure, plus an agentic framework for target-grounded landing-page generation that adapts reusable patterns without copying. Direct code generation from prompts yields generic templates and unsupported claims, which this addresses. A focused web-generation dataset and system.

entry.title: Gen-TAS: A Generative AI-Aided Hardware-Software Task Allocation Framework for FPGA-GPP Heterogeneous Systems

author.name: Mary Kong, Yuqin Zhao, Semih Vazgecen, Cristian Sestito, Themis Prodromakis

entry.summary: Gen-TAS uses RAG-grounded LLMs to allocate tasks between GPP and FPGA in heterogeneous systems, generating explainable strategies with human-in-the-loop selection. A domain-specific application of LLM reasoning to hardware-software co-design.

entry.title: Real-Time Musculoskeletal Surrogates for Pediatric Cerebral Palsy: a Credibility Pilot

author.name: Mohammad Arif Ul Alam

entry.summary: Develops a subject-conditioned causal neural surrogate for real-time musculoskeletal modeling in pediatric cerebral palsy rehabilitation, with leave-one-subject-out validation and calibrated uncertainty on a small nine-child dataset.

entry.title: V2TATC: A Joint Voice-Trajectory Embedding Framework and Dataset for Air Traffic Controller Situational Awareness

author.name: Louis Brusset, Mathurin Petit, Jordan Kam, Alexandre Bayen

entry.summary: V2TATC introduces a joint embedding of air traffic controller voice communications and flight trajectories for situational awareness in congested airspace, showing the modalities share a physical referent. Includes a new dataset.

entry.title: Information-Based Calibration of Uncertainty Quantification in Product-of-Experts Gaussian Process Models

author.name: Yean Hoon Ong, Paolo Barucca, Wei Pan, Jun Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GP-pro-c, a product-of-experts Gaussian process that corrects overestimated posterior variances from local experts via an information-gain-based calibration ratio. Addresses the cubic cost barrier of global GPs while restoring calibrated uncertainty.

entry.title: Predicting the Unpredictable: LLM-powered Long-term Chaotic Time Series Forecasting under Short-term Observations

author.name: Yuhang Yao, Bohan Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes PAC-LLM, a phase-space-aware framework that fuses learned phase-space features with LLM capabilities for long-term chaotic time series forecasting from short-term observations.

entry.title: Adaptive Doubly Robust Off-Policy Evaluation for Ranking Policies under Diverse User Behavior

author.name: Kosuke Iguchi, Ren Kishimoto

entry.summary: Extends Adaptive Inverse Propensity Scoring with doubly robust estimation for off-policy evaluation of ranking policies, addressing variance-bias trade-offs under diverse user browsing behavior.

entry.title: PruneShift: A Framework for Evaluating Decision Reliability in Structured Pruning

author.name: Hao Ye, Gaopeng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces PruneShift, an evaluation framework separating broad surrogate fidelity from the quality of the actual selected pruning decision, proving rank correlation can be near-perfect while selection regret remains maximal and deriving sufficient conditions for reliable selection.

entry.title: Structural Hierarchy and Geometry in Molecular Representation Learning

author.name: David Sulu, Lorenzo Di Fruscia, Jana M. Weber

entry.summary: Studies whether explicitly supervising molecular embeddings with Bemis-Murcko scaffolds changes what self-supervised models learn, and how this interacts with Euclidean versus Lorentz (hyperbolic) contrastive geometry, finding scaffold supervision improves property prediction on several tasks.

entry.title: Forget or Fine-tune? A Comparative Study of Machine Unlearning Strategies for Noisy Label Correction

author.name: Jo\~ao L. P. Santana, Filipe R. Cordeiro

entry.summary: Comparatively evaluates five machine unlearning methods (NegGrad, FT, Random Labeling, SalUn, MUNBa) for noisy-label correction across symmetric, asymmetric, instance-dependent, and open-set noise, clarifying when unlearning substitutes for full retraining.

entry.title: Selection, Representation, and Execution in Sparse Fourier Neural Operators

author.name: Abdul Qadir Ibrahim, Martin Burger

entry.summary: Empirically disentangles sparsity in representation, stored parameters, theoretical operation count, and measured runtime for Fourier Neural Operators, showing coarsening reduces theoretical cost without reducing latency and that these objectives frequently misalign.

entry.title: The Signal in the Noise: An Auditable Reliability Layer for Biomedical Text Classification

author.name: Moustafa Yehia Hassan, Sharon Wong, Woh Kai Xuan

entry.summary: The paper introduces a conservative, auditable spell-correction layer for biomedical NLP pipelines, designed to abstain from edits under uncertainty per a do-no-harm philosophy. It targets systematic OCR-like artifacts in PDF-parsed corpora that silently degrade downstream classifiers.

entry.title: MWIR-4-Plastic: The Identification of Complex End-of-Life Industrial Plastic using Mid-wave Infrared Hyperspectral Imaging and Machine Learning

author.name: Elias Arbash, Andr\'ea de Lima Ribeiro, Filipa Sim\~oes, Ahmed Jamal Afifi, Aldino Rizaldy, Yuleika Madriz, Samuel Thiele, Sandra Lorenz, Margret Fuchs, Pedram Ghamisi, Paul Scheunders, Richard Gloaguen

entry.summary: MWIR-4-Plastic introduces a mid-wave infrared hyperspectral imaging dataset and ML pipeline for identifying complex end-of-life shredded industrial plastics, including underrepresented black plastics. It fills a gap left by laboratory-controlled, intact-plastic datasets that do not support bulk recycling workflows.

entry.title: Leveraging Turn-taking Dynamics for Intent Recognition in Multi-party Conversations

author.name: Galo Castillo-L\'opez, Alexis Lombard, Ga\"el de Chalendar, Nasredine Semmar

entry.summary: The paper introduces turn-transition entropy, a self-supervised auxiliary target modeling turn-taking dynamics, and shows a multi-task setup using it improves intent recognition in multi-party conversations across several pre-trained models. The signal also works as a standalone objective, indicating it carries real information.

entry.title: Cross Lingual Transfer in Tulu Legal Comprehension: Script-Dependent Improvement and RAG-Induced Knowledge Conflict

author.name: Sindhu Shetty, Spurthi Setty, Natan Vidra

entry.summary: Tests three models on classifying legal complaints in low-resource Dravidian language Tulu, showing transliteration across scripts enables preliminary cross-lingual transfer that is heavily script-dependent. Also documents RAG-induced knowledge conflicts in this setting.

entry.title: Not All or None: Dynamic Construction of Target-aware Memory Graph for Conversational Stance Detection

author.name: Yifan Xiang, Bin Liang, Yuqi Huang, Ruifeng Xu, Kam-Fai Wong

entry.summary: Proposes TamGraph, a target-aware memory graph for conversational stance detection that uses entropy-guided backtracking to selectively activate relevant historical statements rather than using all or none of the conversation history.

entry.title: Cloud and On-Premises Deployment of Uzbek Legal RAG via Targeted Retriever Fine-Tuning

author.name: Tatul Danielyan, Mariam Avetisyan, Hrant Davtyan

entry.summary: Reports building and operating an Uzbek legal RAG assistant under two regimes: a cost-capped cloud service and an on-premises deployment restricted to open-weight models on local hardware. Contributes two expert-annotated domain benchmarks for retrieval and QA.

entry.title: StageWell: A Process-Aligned Chinese Corpus for Positive-Psychology Support Dialogue

author.name: Yuxiong Wang, Ziwei Lin, Bo Wang, Yu Zhang, Shiguang Ni

entry.summary: Introduces StageWell, a process-aligned Chinese corpus for positive-psychology support dialogue organized into a six-stage support process, with 12,445 SFT instances and 1,849 DPO preference pairs built via multi-agent whole-dialogue rewriting.

entry.title: Thesis Proposal: Toward a Human-Centered and Perspective-Aware Framework for Reproducible ML Evaluation and AI Alignment

author.name: Deepak Pandita, Christopher M. Homan

entry.summary: A thesis proposal for a human-centered, perspective-aware framework for reproducible ML evaluation and AI alignment that accounts for human disagreement rather than aggregating to consensus via plurality voting. Argues current evaluation obscures minority perspectives.

entry.title: Demand-Side Measurement for Generative Engine Optimization: Constructing and Validating a Million-Persona, Intent-Annotated Buyer Corpus

author.name: Dmitrij \.Zatuchin, Daniil Dzemesjuk

entry.summary: PersonaGen-1M is a corpus of over 1 million synthetic buyer personas with search-intent labels and preferred-source fields, intended as demand-side measurement data for generative engine optimization research on how brands appear in LLM search answers. The authors validate the corpus against staged intent labels across 511 industries. It targets a new measurement problem in AI-mediated commerce.

entry.title: Vocal Music under Phoneme-Conditional Analysis

author.name: Hayoon Kim, Kyogu Lee

entry.summary: Introduces phoneme-conditional analysis to isolate acoustic effects of typologically distinctive phonemes across nine languages and thousands of unaccompanied songs, achieving 85.5% balanced accuracy on nine-way language identification. A rigorous linguistics-meets-ML study on vocal music identity. Cross-disciplinary rather than core AI-safety or frontier-model work.

entry.title: Variable-Granularity Tokenization for High-Resolution Object Detection

author.name: Khayrul Islam

entry.summary: VGTok is a training-free tokenizer that sets per-region patch granularity for high-resolution aerial object detection before the encoder, using morphological separability scoring and a structure-tensor gate within a fixed token budget. Tackles the resolve-few-pixel-objects versus compute tradeoff in ViT detectors. Practical efficiency contribution.

entry.title: Text-Driven Artistic Staging: Pose, Lighting, and Camera References from Paintings

author.name: Yunge Wen

entry.summary: Introduces text-to-editable 3D staging: jointly generating human poses, lighting, and camera configuration from affective text descriptions, with an 11,911-pair dataset built from figurative paintings and a flow-matching transformer supporting variable figure counts and multiple staging alternatives. Creative intersection of art analysis and controllable generation.

entry.title: Efficient Language-to-Vision Feature Injection for Referring Single-Object Tracking

author.name: Han Wang, Yuxuan Liu, Yuhan Sun, Jian Yang, Xiaotong Xu, Yixuan Lv, Zhuang Zhou, Shengyang Li

entry.summary: LVTrack is a pure-transformer referring single-object tracker with a mode-conditioned gated feature injector that adaptively regulates language guidance to prevent semantic drift, directly leveraging a frozen vision-language model to cut alignment-training costs. Solid multimodal tracking contribution.

entry.title: FISICA: A Deployed Service for Plantar-Pressure and Posture Assessment with Ontology-Grounded Recommendation

author.name: Juhwan Song, Heejung Kim, Juntae Noh, Jonghak Ryu, Huiju Park, Junseong Lee, Dohyeon Ahn, Byungwoo Jo

entry.summary: FISICA is a deployed body-assessment service combining a 634-element plantar pressure scale, photographs, and an avatar-solving measurement scheme, with rule-based recommendations and a language model used only for explanation. Notable for its deliberate separation of measurement, decision logic, and LLM explanation in production. A candid systems paper about real deployment.

entry.title: On the Role of MRI Sequences in Cross-Dataset Generalization for Brain Tumor Segmentation

author.name: Henrique Zan Grande, Jo\~ao G. Pitol, Lucas B. Schuck, Rafael V. Serenato, Rayson Laroca, Andre Gustavo Hochuli

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates how individual MRI sequences affect cross-dataset generalization for brain tumor segmentation using a ResUNet framework under controlled domain-shift protocols. Findings guide which modalities to prioritize when annotated target-domain data is scarce.

entry.title: AI-enabled Low-Cost 3D Maize Ear Morphometry Platform at Breeding Scale

author.name: Therin Young, Elijah Rodriguez, Lisa Coffey, Talukder Zaki Jubery, Adarsh Krishnamurthy, Patrick Schnable, Baskar Ganapathysubramanian

entry.summary: Presents a low-cost AI pipeline for 3D maize ear morphometry that reconstructs watertight meshes from 20-second DSLR video via NeRF with automatic metric scaling, validated on 300 diverse inbred ears. Democratizes high-throughput crop phenotyping.

entry.title: Semantic-Spatial Discriminability Enhancement for Generalized Visual Grounding

author.name: Kaiyan Lei, Xu-Yao Zhang

entry.summary: SSDE enhances semantic-spatial discriminability for generalized visual grounding with multi-target and non-target scenarios, improving instance-level decision boundaries when targets are visually similar. Extends the classical referring segmentation paradigm.

entry.title: FlowVVTON: Flow-Guided Mask-Free Video Virtual Try-On

author.name: Shengyao Chen, Xianbing Sun, Liqing Zhang, Jianfu Zhang

entry.summary: FlowVVTON performs mask-free video virtual try-on using optical flow purely as training-time supervision via a flow-warped latent loss across all model layers, avoiding parsing-mask failure under large motions and occlusions.

entry.title: Federated Multi-Task Learning for Bladder Tumor Segmentation and MIBC Classification Using a Hybrid CNN-Transformer Architecture

author.name: Malhar Udmale, Divyanshu Dwivedi, Aarohi Dhand, Sachin Dudda Nagaraju, Mayank Rai, Bagesh Kumar

entry.summary: Presents a federated multi-task learning framework combining Swin hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture for joint bladder tumor segmentation and muscle-invasiveness classification across four clinical centers, with segmentation-guided classification. Handles privacy constraints and scanner variability.

entry.title: Modality Disentangled Learning for Incomplete Multimodal Emotion Recognition: A Primitive Memory Distillation Perspective

author.name: Jiaqi Zhang, Zheng Pang, Mengting Li, Yiqi Wang, Guangyuan Dong, Chao Xue, Yusen Wu, Zihao Li, Huy Phan, Sicheng Zhao, Bj\"orn W. Schuller, Jiachen Luo

entry.summary: MCSeg presents a volumetric pyramid transformer with a Scaling Feature Pyramid bridging single-scale 3D ViT encoders and multi-scale CNN decoders for multi-modal cardiac segmentation, with masked image modeling pre-training. Well-motivated architecture fix for hybrid networks.

entry.title: OCR-Based Field Extraction for Archaeological Pottery Metadata: The CENTURIA Dataset

author.name: Gissu Valentina Naghavi, Dominik Hagmann, Martin Kampel, Irene Ballester

entry.summary: CENTURIA is a dataset of 507 archaeological pottery records with transcriptions, bounding boxes, and structured field labels, benchmarking five OCR models and revealing a large domain gap for zero-shot document analysis on handwritten heritage metadata.

entry.title: RailSyn: Diagnosis-Guided Image Generation for Traceable Data Completion in Railway Foreign Object Detection

author.name: Quan Hao, Chenxi Zhang, Ziyang Tao, Yuyuan Zhou, Yudong Wang, Rui Shi, Lechuan Xu, Changhao Liu, Liguo Zhang

entry.summary: RailSyn is a diagnosis-guided framework for railway foreign object detection data completion, with a real-referenced Inspector localizing task-relevant deficiencies and a requirement-aligned Generator producing traceable synthetic completions.

entry.title: RailGen: Improving Railway Intrusion Detection via Agent-Guided Small-Scale Foreign Object Generation

author.name: Quan Hao, Ziyang Tao, Chenxi Zhang, Yudong Wang, Rui Shi, Liguo Zhang

entry.summary: RailGen is an agent-guided multimodal generation framework that automatically invokes tools to synthesize realistic small-intrusion railway scenes, calibrating positions and fusing foreign objects, to enrich rare-class feature space for long-tailed small-object detection.

entry.title: Pretrained, Curriculum-Tuned, and Ensembled: A Tracer-Aware Interactive Segmentation Pipeline for AutoPET V

author.name: Xinglong Liang, Chunyao Lu, Tianyu Zhang, Jiaju Huang, Tao Tan, Yunchao Yin, Lishan Cai

entry.summary: TRIAGE is a tracer-aware interactive lesion segmentation pipeline for whole-body PET/CT (AutoPET V), combining MAE-pretrained 3D STU-Net with curriculum tuning, ensembling, and tracer-aware auxiliary components to handle FDG vs PSMA differences.

entry.title: VCAR: Training-Free 3DGS Segmentation via View Completeness and Axis-Aware Boundary Refinement

author.name: Kun Cao, Di Wang, Haibin Zhu, Haozhi Huang, Xu Wang, Zheng Shi, Guanghua Yang

entry.summary: VCAR offers training-free 3DGS segmentation via view-completeness-based multi-view voting plus axis-aware boundary refinement, avoiding per-scene feature distillation training overhead and mitigating anisotropic-primitive boundary artifacts.

entry.title: You Should Think About What Needs to Go Right + My List

author.name: Koby Lewis

entry.summary: Argues that AI safety should supplement failure prevention with explicit backchaining from a concrete desirable future, laying out the author's personal vision in four layers and updating their assessment of research agendas accordingly.

entry.title: The optimism of the gaps

author.name: Matthew Tromp

entry.summary: Describes optimism of the gaps: assuming things go well in whichever AI-safety-relevant domain one is not personally scrutinizing, and recommends the correction that all areas are probably going about as poorly as the one you know best.

entry.title: BlobBoards: Robust Markers for Accurate Pose

author.name: James Pritts, Till Sittart, Hendrik Sauer, Silja Jan{\ss}en, Felix Seegr\"aber, David Nakath, Kevin K\"oser

entry.summary: BlobBoards is a fiducial marker system using dense multi-scale Gaussian blob fields for joint detection, identification, and pose estimation, reducing AprilTag median translation error by 70-89% against motion-capture ground truth. Strong classical-vision engineering with robotics applications.

entry.title: DReSG: Diffusion Residuals for Stylized Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Zhongliang Liu, Wenjie Liu, Yang Li

entry.summary: DReSG stylizes 3D Gaussian splatting scenes using diffusion residuals: attention-guided diffusion proposals are represented as residual targets relative to the current render and progressively absorbed into the shared Gaussian scene, avoiding view drift and per-view instability. Nice integration of diffusion priors with 3DGS.

entry.title: Class-Based Heuristic Selection for Solving the Flying Block Puzzle

author.name: Sanyar Ahmadi, Pedram Asadzadeh, Amanj Khorramian

entry.summary: Studies a rigorously NP-complete two-column Flying Block Puzzle whose geometry abstracts clearance constraints from warehouse logistics and multi-agent path finding, and proposes Class-Based Heuristic A*, which adds general move constraints and class-based heuristics to A*. Aimed at hard instances where generic heuristics degrade catastrophically. A solid but niche algorithmic contribution to heuristic search.

entry.title: PhenoIntel: A Lifecycle-Aligned Multi-Agent Web Application for Verified, Accessible Plant Phenotype Analysis

author.name: Narendren S V, Soumyashree Kar

entry.summary: Presents PhenoIntel, a nine-agent web platform for plant phenotype analysis that stages collection, model selection, inference, and reporting, with independent checks preventing failed analyses from being reported as valid measurements, plus uncertainty reporting and statistical assumption checking. A careful reliability-focused applied system. Good engineering exemplar, limited research novelty.

entry.title: Expert Knowledge & Machine Understanding: Bridging Reactome's Ontology with LLM Semantic Embeddings

author.name: Susanna Bravi, Riccardo De Luca, Rosa Sicilia, Christine Nardini, Mario Santoro

entry.summary: Tests whether LLM semantic embeddings of expert-written Reactome pathway descriptions recover the curated global hierarchical structure, probing whether textual relationships mirror higher-order biological relationships defined by human curators. A neat epistemic question linking curation quality and representation geometry. Modest-scale analysis with useful implications for automated knowledgebase expansion.

entry.title: GraM-Diff: A Unified Graph-Mamba Diffusion Framework for EEG-Based Alzheimer's Disease Data Generation and Diagnosis

author.name: M. Tanveer, Ayush Singh Rana, Sanskriti Jain, Arnav Kumar, Aryaman Tiwari, A. Rahaman, A. Quadir, M. Sajid

entry.summary: Proposes GraM-Diff, a classifier-guided Graph-Mamba diffusion model for EEG synthesis and Alzheimer diagnosis, combining graph convolutions for electrode connectivity with Mamba blocks for long-range temporal modeling and latent-space guidance for class-conditional generation.

entry.title: PRIME: Mitigating Subgroup Optimization Competition in Shared CTR Top Networks with Plug-in Residual Input-Conditioned Mixture of Expert

author.name: Heng Yao, Siyun Hou, Tianying Liu, Yulou Shu, Yong He, Chuan Yuan, Kaibin Qiu, Guowei Chen, Jiayu Zhao, Chao Yu, Ke Ding

entry.summary: Identifies subgroup optimization competition in shared CTR model top networks, showing reduced gradient cosine similarity among semantic subgroups, and proposes PRIME, a plug-in residual input-conditioned mixture of experts to resolve it. From an industrial CTR team, it improves multi-task recommendation performance without disrupting established mappings. Practical but domain-specific.

entry.title: Trajectory-Initialized Neural Double Q-Routing for Large-Scale Overhead Hoist Transport Systems

author.name: Cheng Gu, Qiusheng Zhao, Anbang Liu, Shaochong Lin, Max Z. J. Shen

entry.summary: Proposes trajectory-initialized neural double Q-routing for overhead hoist transport fleets in semiconductor fabs, replacing destination-indexed tabular values with neural generalization across sparsely visited routing contexts. It improves startup behavior and information sharing for large-scale industrial routing. Solid industrial RL deployment work.

entry.title: NLP-Driven Knowledge Extraction and Thematic Classification of Translated Ancient Indian Medical Texts

author.name: M. S. Rajeevan, B. Mini Devi, V. S. Anoop, C. Mallikarjuna

entry.summary: Applies NER, BERTopic topic modeling, and Neo4j knowledge graphs to translated ancient Indian medical texts such as the Sushruta Samhita to extract and visualize disease, treatment, and plant entities. Useful as a digital humanities demonstration of standard NLP pipelines on historical corpora.

entry.title: Do MLLMs Really Understand Low-Resource Khmer Documents? A Pilot Study on Khmer Document VQA

author.name: Nimol Thuon, Panhapin Theang

entry.summary: Pilot diagnostic evaluation of open multimodal LLMs on Khmer document VQA using a subset of the KH-FUNSD collection with invoices, receipts, and business forms in Khmer and English. Highlights reliability gaps in low-resource, non-Latin document understanding.

entry.title: Evaluating Multilingual Sentence Embeddings for Translation Error Detection:An English--Greek Contrastive Study

author.name: Eleftherios Kalogeros, Athanasios Ntalakas, Manolis Gergatsoulis, Paschalis Nikolaou, Sotiria-Lito Alexaki

entry.summary: Builds an expert-reviewed contrastive English-Greek dataset of 1,850 examples across fifteen translation error categories from FLORES+, then tests five multilingual embedding models on distinguishing correct translations from minimally modified erroneous ones. Quantifies sensitivity of embeddings to fine-grained translation errors.

entry.title: Ontology-Guided Multi-Agent Extraction of Evaluation Objects from Academic Review Texts: Evidence from Chinese Library and Information Science

author.name: Haolin Chen, Hongyi Dong, Yu Zhu, Yijia Hong, Leiqing Niu, Jiyuan Ye

entry.summary: Proposes an ontology-guided multi-agent framework for extracting evaluation objects from academic review texts, combining candidate discovery, ontology-constrained classification, and domain review, achieving 87.34 entity-level F1 on Chinese library and information science reviews.

entry.title: Stochastic Liquid Deformation Fields: An SDE Generalisation of Closed-Form Continuous-Time Cells for Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Mingzhao Li, Arghya Pal

entry.summary: Extends closed-form continuous-time (CfC) liquid-network deformation fields for dynamic 3D Gaussian splatting with an SDE-based Gaussian noise perturbation on the time gate, recovering the stochastic robustness of liquid networks at training time only. A technical refinement within the 3DGS deformation literature.

entry.title: Coarse to Fine: Iterative Adversarial Neural Cellular Automata for Medical Image Synthesis

author.name: Anh Thi Luu, Nick Lemke, Anirban Mukhopadhyay

entry.summary: StyleGANCA is a lightweight neural cellular automata generative adversarial network with StyleGAN-inspired mapping and adaptive style modulation for multi-scale medical image synthesis, targeting privacy-friendly data generation on resource-constrained hardware. Useful for medical imaging where privacy and compute are binding.

entry.title: Acoustically Grounded Cost Learning for Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Tianrui Hui, Shaofei Huang, Qisong Han, Yaxiong Wang, Lechao Cheng, Zhedong Zheng, Zhun Zhong, Richang Hong, Meng Wang

entry.summary: AGCL reformulates open-vocabulary audio-visual semantic segmentation with category-specific objectives and acoustically grounded cost learning, transforming static audio-agnostic visual-text priors into dynamic audio-grounded representations. Advances a niche multimodal segmentation task with a coherent framework.

entry.title: STARLINC: Satellite Trail Artifact Removal using Inter-Frame Correlation

author.name: Shingeon Kim, Hyeyoon Lee, Dain Kwon, Kanghyun Choi, Sunjong Park, Mi-Ryang Kim, Jeong-Eun Lee, Jinho Lee

entry.summary: STARLINC removes satellite-trail artifacts from astronomical images using inter-frame correlation, addressing Starlink contamination at survey scale without large annotated datasets. A valuable application contribution for astronomy infrastructure.

entry.title: Generative AI Expands the Intellectual Reach of Course Based Undergraduate Research Experiences (CUREs)

author.name: Aditi Babar, Kristin J. Davin, Alex Dornburg

entry.summary: A longitudinal qualitative study across three semesters of a bioinformatics course-based undergraduate research experience showing that embedded generative AI expanded students intellectual reach via personalized scaffolding, changed collaboration dynamics, and shaped scientific reasoning. Education research rather than AI method development. Relevant evidence for how GenAI reshapes STEM pedagogy.

entry.title: A Framework for Object-Centric Predictive Monitoring of Collaborative Processes

author.name: Daniel Calegari, Andrea Delgado, Leonel Pe\~na, Mart\'in Rubio

entry.summary: Connects predictive process monitoring of collaborative inter-organizational processes with object-centric process mining via a formal semantic mapping to OCED-conformant representations, enabling prediction over participants, messages, local executions, and global collaboration cases rather than single-case logs. A careful formal-and-framework contribution for enterprise process analytics. Niche but well constructed.

entry.title: Evidential-Based Higher-Order Set Argumentation Framework

author.name: Shuai Tang

entry.summary: Generalizes evidential argumentation into the Evidential-Based Higher-Order Set Argumentation Framework, which unifies evidential support, higher-order relations, and collective set-based interactions, and provides two complete semantics including an adjacent complete labelling that handles support cycles with multiple truth values. Pure formal argumentation theory. Important within its community, narrow outside it.

entry.title: Regime-Aware Portfolio Management via Retrieval-Augmented LLM-Guided Expert Switching

author.name: Ahmad Asadi, Reza Safabakhsh

entry.summary: Combines a dual-stream variational autoencoder for asset-level and market-wide representations, a retrieval base of historical market regimes and expert performance, and an instruction-tuned LLM that reasons over retrieved evidence to switch portfolio-management experts, with a claimed monotonicity property. Representative of the growing LLM-finance genre. Plausible architecture, but financial backtest rigor is the perennial concern.

entry.title: Depth-Aware Pothole Detection Using YOLO and RT-DETR at the Edge

author.name: Md Monjurul Ahsan Prodhan, Md Nour Hossain

entry.summary: This paper presents depth-aware pothole detection fusing RGB-D sensors with five detector architectures (YOLOv8n, YOLOv8nSeg, YOLOv9t, RT-DETR variants) plus automated depth measurement for severity, evaluated on a custom dataset with adversarial-condition augmentation. It addresses a real infrastructure-management need that 2D-only approaches cannot fully serve. Competent applied computer vision.

entry.title: Training-free Suction Grasp Detection for Deformed Aseptic Cartons Using Vision-Language Models and Geometric Surface Scoring

author.name: Marin Maletic, Goran Vasiljevic

entry.summary: A training-free robotic suction grasp detection system for deformed beverage cartons combining open-vocabulary VLM detection, SAM2 segmentation, and geometric surface scoring. Evaluated on a real robot across deformation levels and cluttered scenes.

entry.title: Conservative Hybrid Graph Networks for Process Systems with Learned Routing

author.name: Paolo Guida

entry.summary: Conservative Hybrid Graph Network embeds learned routing, regime assignment, and removal rates into a fixed transport equation so mass balance holds by construction for industrial process networks with dynamic topologies.

entry.title: RankShift: In-Database Detection and Explanation of Categorical Shifts

author.name: Omair Shafi Ahmed

entry.summary: RankShift detects and explains categorical distribution shifts inside analytical databases using a Pearson-score query that returns calibrated alerts and per-category contributions, validated on HDFS, BGL, and Thunderbird log datasets.

entry.title: Adaptive Multi-Branching for Shallow Decision Tree Induction

author.name: Hanul Park, Jeonghoon Choi, Juseong Kim, Sanghun Sel, Giltae Song

entry.summary: MBNDT trains shallow decision trees end-to-end with differentiable multi-way splits and adaptive branch masks, then converts to deterministic trees, improving tabular accuracy under strict depth budgets while preserving interpretability.

entry.title: A Spectral Identifiability Threshold for Dissipative Rate Recovery from Truncated Liouvillian Spectra

author.name: Yujun Ji, Somyajit Chakraborty

entry.summary: Derives a spectral identifiability threshold for recovering dissipative rates in open quantum systems from truncated Liouvillian spectra, showing population modes carry no dephasing information and giving mode-count lower bounds in a six-qubit Lindblad model.

entry.title: Behavioral Latency as Weak Event-Time Supervision for EEG Reaction-Time Decoding

author.name: Anuar Aimoldin, Ayana Mussabayeva, Yedige Mussabayev, Xue Liu, Kun Zhang

entry.summary: Reformulates EEG reaction-time decoding as event-time posterior modeling, treating behavioral latency as weak supervision over latent response-relevant timing rather than a scalar regression label. Evaluated on the Healthy Brain Network task with subject-disjoint splits.

entry.title: Knowledge Distillation under Teacher Misspecification: An Order-Parameter Analysis of the Gap between Teacher Mimicry and Task Performance

author.name: Kazuyuki Hara, Hideitsu Hino

entry.summary: Analyzes knowledge distillation under teacher misspecification using a closed-form order-parameter framework with a true teacher, teacher, and student, controlling mismatch by a single parameter. Quantifies the gap between teacher mimicry and true task performance.

entry.title: Asynchronous Cooperative Online Learning for Multi-Robot Control under Computational Delays

author.name: Xiaobing Dai, Zewen Yang, Wei Ren, Sandra Hirche

entry.summary: Develops asynchronous cooperative online learning for multi-robot control using distributed Gaussian process regression under heterogeneous computational delays, with calibrated uncertainty handling for safety.

entry.title: HoopMind: A Real-Time Neural Game-Tree System for Opponent-Aware Possession Planning

author.name: Yibo Gong, Cong Guo, Jiacheng Ding

entry.summary: Fuses five public basketball data sources into a 4.23M-shot dataset spanning 21 seasons and builds HoopMind, a real-time neural game-tree system modeling half-court possessions as sequential games with opponent-aware shot-value modeling.

entry.title: Event-triggered Control and Online Learning for Networked Systems under Computational Delays

author.name: Xiaobing Dai, Armin Lederer, Zewen Yang, Sihua Zhang, Lu Wan, Yang Tang, Sandra Hirche

entry.summary: Derives tracking-error bounds for event-triggered in-network online learning control under computational delays, connecting learning cost, triggering, and network delay in a single guarantee framework.

entry.title: SMOTE-VAR: An Uncertainty-Aware Oversampling Method for Predicting Depression Remission in University Students
